column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT i.id AS "Invoice Id", i.status AS "Status", i.tipo_dte AS "Tipo DTE", i.numero_control AS "Numero Control", i.codigo_generacion AS "Codigo Generacion", i.fec_emi AS "Fec Emi", i.hor_emi AS "Hor Emi", i.tipo_moneda AS "Tipo Moneda", c.id AS "Client Id", c.display_name AS "Client Name", o.id AS "Office Id", o.name AS "Office Name", i.loan_transaction_id AS "Loan Transaction Id", i.savings_transaction_id AS "Savings Transaction Id", i.client_transaction_id AS "Client Transaction Id", COALESCE(s.total_gravada, 0) AS "Total Gravada", COALESCE(s.total_exenta, 0) AS "Total Exenta", COALESCE(s.total_no_suj, 0) AS "Total No Suj", COALESCE(s.total_pagar, 0) AS "Total Pagar", r.nombre AS "Receptor Nombre", r.nit AS "Receptor NIT", i.mh_validation_status AS "MH Validation Status", i.mh_job_id AS "MH Job Id", i.mh_transmission_id AS "MH Transmission Id", i.mh_transmission_status AS "MH Transmission Status", i.mh_submitted_at AS "MH Submitted At", i.mh_processed_at AS "MH Processed At", i.mh_last_error AS "MH Last Error" FROM m_invoice i LEFT JOIN m_invoice_summary s ON s.invoice_id = i.id LEFT JOIN m_invoice_receiver r ON r.invoice_id = i.id LEFT JOIN m_loan_transaction lt ON lt.id = i.loan_transaction_id LEFT JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = lt.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_savings_account_transaction sat ON sat.id = i.savings_transaction_id LEFT JOIN m_savings_account sa ON sa.id = sat.savings_account_id LEFT JOIN m_client_transaction ct ON ct.id = i.client_transaction_id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = COALESCE(l.client_id, sa.client_id, ct.client_id) LEFT JOIN m_office o ON o.id = COALESCE(lt.office_id, sat.office_id, ct.office_id) WHERE i.fec_emi >= '${startDate}' AND i.fec_emi <= '${endDate}' AND (${officeId} = -1 OR COALESCE(lt.office_id, sat.office_id, ct.office_id) = ${officeId}) AND (${clientId} = -1 OR COALESCE(l.client_id, sa.client_id, ct.client_id) = ${clientId}) AND (o.id IS NULL OR o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%')) ORDER BY i.fec_emi DESC, i.id DESC

column.value: Listado de facturas DTE por fecha de emision, oficina y cliente
